, Reason for Mistake: In Step 3, after the WebSurfer correctly extracted the text from the CANF page stating "participating in the Bay of Pigs invasion in April 1961", the Planner incorrectly concluded that the year was "1960". The Planner failed to accurately read or interpret the data it had already retrieved, introducing a factual error that propagated through the rest of the conversation.
